Name: Fae's Ear Pack
Author: FaerieFangs0
Description:
I've been away from modding for a while, and decided to spontaneously get back into it. My original elf ear mod worked, sure, but it was kinda janky, and not as polished as I would have liked, and didn't have *options*. Now that I have a little more experience with spriting, we have that! You can now choose from 3 ear shapes, as well as having them as accessories, so they don't take up the hat slot. Some hats may clip through though, so be warned. I thought different shapes would be a fun idea, because hey, I dunno about you, but I like the character that different ear shapes add. If you ever wanted to be a drow elf, or perhaps a little goblin menace, or you just didn't like the previous design, you now have some options for that. Enjoy your newfound ear freedom, friends. 

﻿I decided to remake and release this mod in preparation for and as a sort of teaser for an NPC I'm working on. Why ears? Well, that's a surprise. The original version of my ear mod is still available, and still works, but consider this one an upgrade.
